Then, he turns around and travels east for 8 hours at the same speed. The distance he covers going east is:
\[ 18 \, \text{mph} \times 8 \, \text{hours} = 144 \, \text{miles} \]

To find his net displacement, we subtract the westward distance from the eastward distance:
\[ 144 \, \text{miles} - 90 \, \text{miles} = 54 \, \text{miles} \]

Therefore, Elvis is \boxed{54} miles away from his house.
